title: RDS Proxy 連線設定 — 取代 0.0.0.0/0 資料庫暴露
content: Amplify SSR Lambda 無法直接連線至 RDS PostgreSQL。已嘗試 VPC + Security Group ID 方式但 Amplify Console 無 VPC 設定選項且不支援 Security Group 作為來源規則。本卡片實作 RDS Proxy 作為正式解決方案，讓 Lambda 透過 AWS 私有網路連線至 RDS，消除 0.0.0.0/0 的安全風險。
userStory: RDS Proxy 資料庫安全連線

findings: Amplify SSR Lambda from ap-east-1 has no published dedicated IP CIDR ranges (verified via ip-ranges.amazonaws.com)
Amplify Console (Gen 1 Hosting SSR) does not expose VPC configuration UI; cannot attach Lambda to VPC subnets/SG
AWS rejects Security Group ID as source when editing an existing IPv4 CIDR inbound rule
Current workaround: 0.0.0.0/0 with sslmode=require + strong password (qiHmc2SskwvSQGN)
evidence.residual: RDS Proxy incurs ~$10.8/month additional cost. VPC peering remains unavailable unless Amplify Gen 1 adds VPC support.

comments.name: System
